steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Jesus said "Where two or three gather in my name, there am I with them" (Matthew 18:20). Christians believe worship can be both corporate (together) and private (individual). | Exam Tip: When comparing worship styles, remember that both have the same purpose (honouring God) but different methods. Catholic and Anglican Christians tend to prefer liturgical worship; Baptist, Methodist and Pentecostal Christians prefer non-liturgical or informal worship. | RS Exam Tips — Forms of Worship: 1. For Forms of Worship questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Explain two different forms of Christian worship. | "Liturgical worship is better than non-liturgical worship." Evaluate this statement.
